data.title: The Thursday call
data.situation: The next day, Lin chose the flat near the station from her shortlist. Its advert was a week old, so she phoned the estate agent to enquire whether it was still available. It was. The current tenant would leave at the end of the month, so Lin could move in early next month. The agent offered an appointment to see the flat on Thursday at six. A bus passed as he spoke, and Lin heard Tuesday. Because Tuesday clashed with her shift, she repeated the day to check. 'Thursday,' he said, then gave her the address: 18 Park Road. Lin repeated the street number, and he confirmed it. Thursday suited her. She saved the address and agreed to meet him outside the building.
data.goal: Check whether the flat is available, find out when moving in is possible, and confirm the visit time and address after a phone misunderstanding.
data.zhSupport: 林因通勤太久联系一套离办公室较近的公寓。电话噪音使她把星期四听成星期二；她需要核对看房时间、地址及可入住时间。先自己用英文说，再看示例。

glossary.zh: 现在仍可租到；尚未被租走
glossary.note: still 追问广告发布后状态是否发生变化；Is the flat still available? 是自然问法。
英式英语。原课程释义偏重房屋买卖；本场景的租赁业务用法另有剑桥词典支持。
enquire 为英式拼写；enquire whether the flat is available 可用于较正式的问询。

glossary.text: an appointment to see the flat
glossary.note: appointment 是约定时间的见面；整句是语境组合，不是必须逐字背诵的固定搭配。

glossary.zh: 搬入；开始在新住所居住
glossary.note: 常问 When could I move in?，与看房日期不同。
电话里可重复门牌号和街道名，再请对方确认；这是沟通功能，不是不可拆的固定搭配。
英式英语中的住房名词；这里是出租广告中的整套公寓。

glossary.zh: 可得到的；这里指可租的
glossary.note: 形容词，在房源语境表示现在仍可供租用。
可指在特定时间会面或参观；这里指与中介约好看房。
可包含门牌号、街道名和城市；电话核对时不要只问街名。
英式拼写；口语中也可用 ask。
confirm the time / address；对方在故事中 confirmed the number。

glossary.text: Did you say Tuesday or Thursday
glossary.zh: 你说的是周二还是周四？
glossary.note: 重复两个听到的可能选项；日期可按实际情况替换。 本项目构式/表达组合，不冒充原资料固定搭配。
礼貌请求给出信息；整个请求句由具体信息补全。 本项目构式/表达组合，不冒充原资料固定搭配。

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask whether an advertised home can still be rented
retrievalPrompts.cue: The advert is a week old. You call about the home and want to know whether anyone has taken it. Ask one clear question.
acceptableAnswers: Is the flat still available to rent?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Available asks about the current status of the flat. Still is useful because the advert may be out of date.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 房源广告已经发布一周。打电话询问这套公寓现在是否还能租到。
checks: 是否询问现在的出租状态？
是否表达广告发布之后状态可能已经变化？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 问当前状态；不用把广告内容重复一遍。

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask for the earliest possible moving date
retrievalPrompts.cue: The current tenant leaves at the end of the month. Ask the agent when you could start living in the flat.
acceptableAnswers: What is the earliest date I could move into the flat?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Move in means begin living there. Keep the moving date separate from the date of a visit.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 现在的住户月底搬走。问中介你最早什么时候能开始住进去。
checks: 是否询问开始居住的时间？
是否把入住日和看房日分清？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 这里问实际入住，不是参观房子的日期。

retrievalPrompts.function: Clarify a visit day after hearing it incorrectly
retrievalPrompts.cue: The agent offers a visit at six, but noise makes Tuesday and Thursday hard to distinguish. Tuesday conflicts with work. Check the day before agreeing.
acceptableAnswers: Could you confirm that the appointment is on Thursday at six?
Sorry, did you say Tuesday or Thursday at six?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Repeat the two possible days or ask for confirmation. The exact day matters because one option conflicts with work.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 电话里听不清：中介说周二还是周四六点看房？周二与你的工作冲突。确认日期后再答应。
checks: 是否确认了不确定的日期？
是否用重复两个选项或请求核实的方式澄清？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 合理澄清方式都可以；未使用某个目标表达就记未观察。

retrievalPrompts.function: Check the full location before ending the call
retrievalPrompts.cue: You heard Park Road, but you need the building number as well. Ask for the complete location and check the number you wrote down.
acceptableAnswers: Could you give me the full address, including the building number? Is it 18 Park Road?
Could you confirm the address for me? I wrote down 18 Park Road.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: An address includes the building number as well as the street. Repeating the number gives the agent a chance to correct a mistake.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你听到了街道名，但还缺门牌号。请中介给出完整地点，并核对你写下的十八号。
checks: 是否重复门牌号给对方纠正的机会？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 地址应包含门牌号和街道；具体核对比笼统说没听懂更有效。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer phone clarification to a different home enquiry
transferPrompt.cue: A student calls about a room near campus. The advert may be old, and the current occupant leaves on the twenty seventh. The agent offers a visit on Monday or Friday at five, but the line is unclear. Without reopening Lin's call, ask if the room can still be rented, when you could live there, and which visit day and building details are correct.
acceptableAnswers: Is the room still available? When could I move in? Could you confirm whether the appointment is on Monday or Friday at five, and give me the full address?
Can I still rent the room, and what is the earliest move in date? Sorry, did you say Monday or Friday at five? What is the address?
transferPrompt.feedback: The home, occupant, and possible days have changed. Keep the information steps: check availability, ask about moving in, then repeat the uncertain day and request the complete address.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 你是找校园附近房间的学生。广告可能过时，原住户二十七日搬走；电话中听不清看房是周一还是周五五点。询问能否租到、最早入住日，并核实看房日期和完整地址。
checks: 是否依次核实房源、入住日、看房安排和地址？
是否适应了新人物和新日期？
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 先核状态，再问入住，最后核对不确定的安排与地点。

data.easySummary: Lin calls about a flat. She asks if she can rent it and when she can move in. The call is hard to hear. She checks the day, time and address.
data.easySummaryZh: 林打电话问公寓能不能租、何时入住。电话听不清，所以她核对日期、时间和地址。
